rules.title: Reasonable route
rules.text: Use a reasonable direct route. A safe diversion for roadworks or traffic is permitted when supported by trip evidence; the shortest route is not automatically required.

rules.title: Notify material changes
rules.text: Explain a material detour and likely fare impact when safely possible. A request for the fastest route is not blanket consent to unexplained extra distance.

rules.title: Fare adjustment
rules.text: Refund only the supported excess attributable to an unjustified diversion. An estimated quote alone does not prove overcharging; assess tolls and road conditions.

rules.title: Evidence uncertainty
rules.text: GPS gaps and unavailable data are uncertainty, not proof of misconduct. Prior dispute counts alone must not determine liability.
